facts.fact: Graphic Online reports that the primary National Data Centre in Accra and a secondary centre at KNUST in Kumasi, managed by NITA with Alcatel-Lucent and Huawei Technologies Ghana, will host ministries', departments' and agencies' applications, initially email, antivirus and document management systems; the launch was held the day before the 2016-01-26 article, so 2016-01-25.

note: carried from nationaldatacentres; no document opened
